subject: ACME POC - success criteria, evaluation plan, and access provisioning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: ACME POC - success criteria, evaluation plan, and access provisioning

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC kicked off: 

Summary & success criteria (what ACME wants to validate)
- Latency: 95th-percentile inference latency under 250ms for typical queries (avg input length ~120 tokens).
- Cost: sustained per-1k-token cost below the target you shared.
- Accuracy / safety: match or exceed your baseline on the 200-example eval set (we'll run existing evals you share).
- Integration: simple API integration and a working demo in your staging environment within the 2-week trial.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Grant access (API key or service account) + provide IP allowlist + SSO invite.
- Week 1: Integration + run smoke tests and shared eval set (we'll run parallel runs).
- Week 2: Performance tuning (batching/quantization suggestions) and final readout.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (sales lead) for coordination, Dev Patel (onboarding engineer) for technical setup and troubleshooting.
- Acme: Sarah (product owner) and Tom (IT/security) for access and environment prep.

Access we need from you
- API key or SSO invite for two Acme test users (staging).
- IP allowlist: Can you provide the CIDR(s) or public IPs you will call from? We will provide the ingest IPs on our side if you need them.
- If you prefer SSO, share the IdP metadata or the email addresses to invite.

Attachments: I attached a short POC success criteria doc and a service-account setup guide.

Next steps (action items)
- Sarah: confirm owners and timeline, send the shared eval set (CSV or JSON).
- Tom: send IP ranges or SSO metadata.
- Marissa/Dev: we will provision credentials as soon as we receive the above.

If that looks good I can provision a short-lived API key and invite your two staging users today.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_poc_success_criteria.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: service-account-setup.md (text)

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME POC - success criteria, evaluation plan, and access provisioning

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with our expectations. A few quick answers: 

- Owners: I'll be the product owner for the evaluation and will own the eval dataset. Tom will own the network/security side.
- Eval set: I'll upload the initial 200-example eval CSV to the Drive link you shared by end of day today.
- Access: We prefer SSO (Okta) for user invites, but it will be helpful to have an API key for automation. Could you send instructions and the expected lifetime for the API key?
- IP allowlist: Tom will follow up with the exact CIDRs, but we will likely call from our staging pool: 54.234.12.0/24 and 18.198.45.0/24. Confirm if those are compatible.

Also one compliance question from procurement: do you have a standard DPA/ordering doc we can review while the POC runs?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the trial.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Li | Product Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.li@acme.com

Perfect — thanks Sarah and Tom. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) SSO invite: we can invite your two staging users via Okta; please confirm the two emails. If you prefer IdP metadata we can accept that too.
2) IP allowlist: we will allow 54.234.12.0/24 and 18.198.45.0/24 on our ingress. No additional public callbacks expected for the initial POC; if that changes we'll let you know.
3) API key: we provisioned a short-lived API key scoped to the POC workspace. Key details:
   - Key type: scoped API key (server-side only)
   - Lifetime: 14 days (we can extend)
   - Usage limits: 60 requests/min default for the POC workspace (we can increase if needed)

I attached the POC success criteria doc and a service-account setup guide. Dev will send the API key and SSO invites after Tom confirms the two staging emails.

Procurement/DPA: attaching a standard DPA + ordering PDF for your legal/procurement team. If procurement@acme.com wants a copy, please let me know and I'll loop them in.

Action items (owners):
- Sarah: confirm two staging emails and upload eval set (due EOD today).
- Tom: confirm whether you'll send IdP metadata or want invites (due EOD today).
- Marissa/Dev: send API key + SSO invites after confirmations.

Thanks — we'll aim to have the environment ready by Monday so you can start integration testing.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
